title: The Dream Told before Breakfast
youtube_title: The Dream Told before Breakfast | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Yelena about a dream told slowly before breakfast. Yelena wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
